description: This Java class defines the Alert entity in the OpenMRS notification system. It encapsulates properties like alert ID, text, expiration date, recipients, and status indicators, along with methods to manage recipients and mark alerts as read.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Represents a notification alert in the system, including details about its content, status, recipients, and metadata.

methods.name: getAlertId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this alert.

methods.name: setAlertId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this alert.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Retrieves the user who created this alert.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Assigns the creator of this alert.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the alert was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the alert.

methods.name: getDateToExpire
methods.description: Fetches the expiration date of the alert.

methods.name: setDateToExpire
methods.description: Sets the expiration date for this alert.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the alert message text.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the message text of the alert.

methods.name: getSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Indicates if the alert is satisfied when any recipient satisfies the condition.

methods.name: isSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Checks if the alert is satisfied by any recipient.

methods.name: setSatisfiedByAny
methods.description: Defines whether the alert is satisfied by any recipient.

methods.name: getAlertRead
methods.description: Checks if the alert has been read.

methods.name: isAlertRead
methods.description: Returns true if the alert is marked as read.

methods.name: setAlertRead
methods.description: Marks the alert as read or unread.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the user who last changed the alert.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last modified the alert.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the last change date for the alert.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Gets the set of recipients associated with this alert.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Assigns the recipients for this alert.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient to the alert.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Adds a user as a recipient to the alert.

methods.name: removeRecipient
methods.description: Removes a recipient from the alert.

methods.name: getRecipient
methods.description: Finds and returns the AlertRecipient corresponding to a specific user.

methods.name: markAlertRead
methods.description: Marks the alert as read for the authenticated user.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the alert.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the ID of the alert, implementing OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the alert, implementing OpenmrsObject interface.
